packet.question: Does control C1 and its evidence support the monthly access review requirement for each population?

criteria.control_fit: The control addresses all privileged accounts, approved-owner review and monthly deadline within each population.
criteria.implementation: Applicable configuration/test evidence establishes that the described control is enabled, owned and covers the population.
criteria.execution: Applicable November records establish review by approved owners of all accounts and recorded decisions by November 30. Late receipt alone is not late execution.

limitations: Synthetic source assertions; authenticity and population completeness are assumed for this exercise.
No broader operational effectiveness or regulatory compliance conclusion.

sources.text: Approved owners must review all privileged accounts on AWS and on-premises production servers monthly, by month end.
Control C1 requires approved owners to review all privileged accounts monthly for its stated population and record decisions by month end.
Configuration test for C1 on November 30 confirms the review process is enabled, assigned to approved owners and includes all privileged accounts in the stated population.
November C1 review report: approved owners reviewed all privileged accounts in the stated population on November 28; decisions are recorded. This report was received December 2.
